capabilities: track progress across four expansion zones (Confort, Miedo, Aprendizaje, Crecimiento)
capture GTD tasks instantly with context tags into an inbox
track daily, weekly, and monthly habit streaks
earn XP and ranks from level 1 to 10 with daily streak multipliers
export and import JSON backups for the GOZ Desktop App
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README and feature names are partly in Spanish.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track personal-growth zones, GTD task capture, habit streaks, and gamified leveling in one place.

relations.evidence: Export & import JSON backups to keep data synced with the GOZ Desktop App.

summary: Gamified personal-growth tracker that adds four expansion zones, a GTD quick-capture inbox, habit streaks, and RPG-style XP leveling.
